literal_meaning: দাঁত কিঁচানো বা দাঁত চেপে ধরা
figurative_meaning_en: To scold with a distorted or grimacing facial expression
similar_in_english: To grit one's teeth in anger
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দাঁত খিচিয়ে বলল, 'এবার থেকে আর এমন করবি না।'
মা দাঁত খিচানো করে ছেলেকে বকল।
example_sentences_in_english: She scolded him with a grimace, saying, 'Don't do that again.'
The teacher reprimanded the student while gnashing her teeth in frustration.
note: This idiom vividly captures the non-verbal aspect of disapproval in Bengali communication.
